# Source attribution and distribution notices

Ponytail: dietrichgebert/ponytail, `96608e078b2d5ea607c5c3b8b5a54d1c1fba6846`. Only the unmodified core `skills/ponytail/SKILL.md` and actual [MIT license](ponytail/LICENSE), Copyright (c) 2026 DietrichGebert, are selected. Their raw Git blob bytes are pinned in `sources.lock.json`. Pegatus-owned guidance applies project-context precedence, task-only activation and existing verification rules; the original's session modes/commands are passive reference content. No external installation or runtime network access is needed.

.NET resources: dotnet/skills, 9864ca798f9448ef954ad1f05baf0dfca6501d51. [MIT license](dotnet-skills/LICENSE), .NET Foundation and Contributors. Only dotnet, dotnet-advanced, dotnet-data, dotnet-test and dotnet-aspnetcore are packaged. All audited skill folders, supporting resources and named dotnet-test agents are present; passive metadata is not host plugin activation. Plugin READMEs linking excluded plugins/experiments are audit inputs, not package entry points.

ECC adaptations: affaan-m/ECC, b92f181b3b748d1abbc2afd94af6aa7d8c8fca29. [MIT license](ecc/LICENSE), Affaan Mustafa. Pegatus role/workflow/rule bodies are adaptations, not native ECC agent/runtime copies. Vercel: vercel-labs/agent-skills, 063bee94c3f4df8453406c830b0a7df0f2860278. Both complete skill folders are packaged. The retained [README](vercel-agent-skills/README.md) and SKILL frontmatters declare MIT; metadata author is vercel. No root LICENSE exists at the pinned commit. No full copyright notice is fabricated or inferred. **Distribution notice gap:** obtaining/reviewing the applicable full notice remains a release-distribution gate. Three Pegatus compatibility bridges repair upstream aggregate-guide paths while original upstream bytes remain intact.

All copied source bytes are SHA-256 validated against sources.lock.json. Bridges and overlays are separate Pegatus files; stack activation follows actual task/framework/version. No runtime network fetch is required for these resources.

The lock records audited checkout bytes, which can differ from raw Git blob encoding. In particular, Vercel's audited files use CRLF; scoped `.gitattributes` preserves those bytes across Windows/Linux checkouts. This package does not claim the audited hashes are raw Git blob hashes.
